---
title: "ssoosshd config check"
description: "Check the configuration without starting the server."
---

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in server/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Loads the configuration exactly as serve and sign do (the same file search or --config, defaults.yaml, the ldap.schema preset, then the file) and runs the same validation, but reports every problem instead of stopping at the first: settings a start refuses, in every section; keys nothing reads, each with the file it is in and the closest real key; the TLS key pair, the cert_options templates and policies, and the mail templates and relay settings; and the warnings a start logs.

Nothing is contacted: no database, directory, broker, CA key source or identity provider. Local files the configuration names (the TLS pair, ssh_key_file, password files, NATS certificates) are read, as a start reads them. Use ldap probe and the admin diagnostics page for the connections.

--show-sources adds every effective setting and the layer it came from (default, preset or file). Secrets are redacted as on the admin configuration page.

Exit status: 0 when the configuration is valid, warnings included; 1 when it has any error, when --strict is given and a key is unknown, or when the command itself fails.

## Synopsis

```
ssoosshd config check [flags] [args]
```

## Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | bool | `false` | print the report as JSON |
| `--show-sources` | bool | `false` | list every effective setting and where its value came from |
| `--strict` | bool | `false` | treat unknown keys as errors |

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoosshd`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to the ssoosshd config file |
